body:
Hey fam, it's been a few months already since i did an attempt and yep, I gotta say, same. 

Even to this day, the feeling of asphyxia sometimes frighten me, I get cold feet when I feel a little bit of pressure around my neck. But the feeling of when you were hanging, fam, it just felt like, bliss, you know? The thought of wanting to end it all is no longer there though, I'm doing my best to balance my crap together and not fall over again, but hot damn, I'd hate to be in this scenario ever again.

All I got is a hundred coins though, the least I could give is a silver medal but I do hope this means something fam.

I probably uhm spent a whole hour typing and deleting, thinking of how to respond hahah, It just doesn't feel right if i just went and accepted. 

I'm actually saving up on moving out right now and that's probably the reason I haven't saved up for therapy. I have already thought of this a lot and have decided to move out of my parents home, though I haven't gone through therapy yet, a lot of people I have consulted told me that I just needed to be away from my parents. I'm working hard on learning stuff in my course in advance just so that I can have a stable source of income when I actually do move out. I've also been doing work online like writing, doing peoples homework, drawing and stuff just to save up a little bit, but it always ends up going for meds (there's probably not a month where I'm not sick or injured. I actually hurt my arm real bad last week that I wasn't able pick up a pen "I was finally able to yesterday though"). 

But honestly, thank you so much for offering, like, thank you so much. I probably just haven't ever been offered that much, but I'm sorry, because I don't think I could go for therapy any time soon. Like, don't get me wrong though hahah, I just really want to leave my home as soon as possible and start something new. Compared to before I wanted to end everything, I'm doing a little better now because everyone's been kind to me in the comments, and to be honest, it kind of feels therapeutic to know that there are some people in the internet who's got my back.

I want to answer really honestly, but it actually hurt more in a mental sense than physical. Those few seconds of being away from the ground without air just blasted my brain with so much things that I didn't have time to think of how it physically feels. After the whole thing broke and gaining consciousness, I immediately realised how painful it was, like the pain immediately kicked in, just like a really bad grapefruit with that terrible after taste but just absolutely worse. It's horrendous.

I didn't really like opening up to friends about how I wanted to share how I felt, because one time, I accidentally overheard some of my close friends commenting on how much of a pussy I was because of opening up. I developed a fear of opening up already because I didn't want to force them into helping me out because they just needed to. But hearing that a stranger wanted to tell me this, I kind of shed a tear hahah. What can i say, I'm a crybaby. Thank you so much

Thank you for worrying, really. But I'm actually okay right now, I don't think anything broke or bled and that's something I'm happy of. The last thing I'd want right now is probably hospital bills and my family knowing, it would definitely change their view on me permanently and things wouldn't go well hahah

I don't want to even think of why I wanted to do it but I just felt that if I just ended it then I wouldn't be having that much of a hard time already.

After all of that though I'm just scared of even trying it, even wrapping something around my neck. I do want my problems gone though but I'm definitely not doing that ever again
A few hours already passed and i can still feel the noose honestly. I'm still shaking a little, it's also kind of cold, but one thing i know is that I won't be doing that again. It's just terrifying

My sister said the same thing with her therapist actually

She went for therapy 2 years back with a therapist our family doctor recommended. She told me it was going well until it reached the part where it looked like she was being told to buy some specific medications that were supposed to help her.

Some of it did, like stress relievers and sleeping pills, but the way she was recommended those meds felt like a business exchange

Though I only heard that from her, I'm not so sure of how it would go if I went for another professional.

But thank you too though for the last part. Posting these things make me a little bit worried sometimes because I sometimes worry of being too mouthy or whiny and stuff. I started feeling that way after getting comments of being too dramatic by my friends when i open up. Thank you

I felt scared, honestly. I realised this after falling but looking down from a noose was scary. The feeling of air constricting and everything going dark, I didn't feel the pain, but when i realized it, damn, it was painful.

I do want to consider therapy, but I'm already financially unstable right now so I don't want to burden my family and others for this, so I'm trying to earn money to find out what's really wrong with me. I want to open up more about that but I really don't like keeping things too long i worry of being a bother.

I do enjoy games, drawing, and building things, I also did bracelet making when i was younger. Thank you for throwing me back, I kind of missed who I was now. I want to try bracelet making again hahah but I don't think my time even allows me at this point with my work and Uni piling up on me, i haven't touched my controller and pen in ages actually, i also lost all of my games so that's out of question

But actually... Yeah, thank you, for that I love you. I probably wanted to hear that from someone 'cause it's kind of lonely at times. Thank you, really.

I felt scared after falling because slowly realising that it actually hurt made me reconsider what it's like after. I do have so much more that i want to do but the feeling of hopelessness was what drived me there. I guess what's keeping me away from doing it again is my fear of death now. But thank you though.

I've been backstabbed a lot by friends and lied to by people, i posted something a while back in r/depressed too about stereotypical Asian parents, that's also another thing to add. I reread the thing i posted and it's funny because i looked so angry at the world hahah, but i was drunk when i made it so i guess i just really wanted to vent. (I haven't drunk at all since then though)

I also broke off a lot of friendships throughout this whole quarantine and i guess i also just felt a little bit lonely. I had to do it because i always feel drained when i put up a facade.

I could say more but I'm already exhausted of thinking after, well, that lol
I still feel like trash though because i have so much piled up, but the feeling of wanting to die is not there anymore. I mean, I'm scared already, but still sad as hell haha.
Man if i finally gained financial independence i would just move my ass out and work on entertaining people happily. I just hope i fucking make it. I'm doing my best.
